description: This file defines the ColumnDataLabelRenderer class responsible for rendering data labels on column charts within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for formatting, drawing, and calculating label positions.

classes.name: ColumnDataLabelRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for displaying data labels on column charts, handling label formatting, positioning, and drawing.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space used by data labels and prepares label entries.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the data labels on the chart.

methods.name: CalcPositions
methods.description: Calculates the positions of data labels based on the specified label position.
